title: Settings
environmentNote: A change applies at once, without a restart. What is not set here keeps the value of the environment variable of the same purpose, or its default.

sectionHelp.history: How long the records and the temporary copies are kept. Older records are deleted by a cleaning that runs every six hours.

field.backup_concurrency: Virtual machines backed up at the same time
field.storage_alert_percent: Tell Slack when a backup storage is this full
field.task_history_retention_days: Keep the history of the backups and restores
field.file_browser_ttl_minutes: Keep a copy opened to browse a backup
field.login_max_attempts: Failed logins before an account is locked

fieldHelp.backup_concurrency: The other backups wait for a free place, in the order they were started, also when this changes. The highest value is the number of processes of the backup worker (BACKUP_MAX_CONCURRENCY).
fieldHelp.storage_alert_percent: One message to the Slack hook chosen for the storage (Tasks > Clean backup) when its disk reaches this usage, checked every 15 minutes. No message while it stays above, a new one after it went back under.
fieldHelp.task_history_retention_days: The list in Tasks > Backup and Tasks > Restore, and the counters of the dashboard.
fieldHelp.audit_retention_days: Who did what, in Parameters > Audit log.
fieldHelp.file_browser_ttl_minutes: The copy of a backup that you open to browse its files is deleted after this time without use.
fieldHelp.jwt_lifetime_minutes: After this time a person has to log in again. It applies to the next logins.
fieldHelp.login_lock_minutes: An administrator can unlock an account earlier from the users page.
